quest.title: Those Searching for the Mysterious Island
quest.description: While wandering in the wilderness, you hear two tourists crying for help, and you and Paimon decide to aid them...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Mora x17050, Adventurer's Experience x8, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.num: Where the Springs Return: Act I
chapter.title: Those Searching for the Mysterious Island

talks.objective: Go play out in the wilds near the People of the Springs

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, what an amazing view! And we can even see some Koholasaurs here and there! Hey, why don't we try to get a picture with one or two of them in the wild?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But what if they try to bite us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well... they're so cute, they probably won't do that, right...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's happening over there?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Help! Somebody help us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Wild Koholasaurs are actually biting people!

choices.text: It's time for us to save the day again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, those two are in trouble! The legendary {NICKNAME} and {M#his}{F#her} trusty sidekick Paimon will not stand by idly!

choices.text: Seems those pictures we wanted will have to wait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we can save those for later! We can't just stand around when someone's calling for help!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The defeated Koholasaurs scatter and run away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Judging from your clothes, you must be scholars from Sumeru, right?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Yes, I'm Karya, and this is my senior, Viramdra. Thank you so much for saving us. That was a little too close...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Don't mention it! Handling these sort of things is practically second nature to us by now. Paimon is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still, it seems that all the Koholasaurs just ran off... We need to capture at least one alive.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Capture one alive?

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Correct. Say, I can see you are very skilled at dealing with them. Do you think you could use me as live bait to help us capture one? I will pay you for the effort!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, well...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Apologies. Viramdra has been hyper-focused on his research, so please, don't be too hard on him...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, no worries! But why did you approach a whole group of wild Koholasaurs? And what's this talk about "capturing them"?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't tell me you want to get a picture with them, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's pretty sure that's not what they're trying to do!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: I'm sure we must look very silly... The fact of the matter is that we're searching for a mysterious island from a certain legend. It's said that a very important clue about the island can be found on Koholasaurs, so...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Approaching them without the help of a guide from the People of the Springs was certainly an unwise choice on our part.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A mysterious island?

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Yes. There's a legend from the People of the Springs that mentions a mysterious island, and Viramdra believes the key to his research can be found there.

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Ahem... Are you certain you two won't consider my proposal to capture one?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Some proposal... There's no way we'd be willing to use a person as live bait!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Then I suppose discussing it any further will just be a waste of time. I must come up with another solution...

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Ahem... Viramdra!

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: Oh, alright... You did rescue Karya and I just now, and I suppose I should express some gratitude. Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A little awkward, but Paimon'll take it...

dialogues.speaker: Viramdra
dialogues.text: We should move on, Karya.

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Yes, thank you again. My apologies... Viramdra really doesn't have the best people skills.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's alright, bye now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really don't see a pair of adventurers like those two every day!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But anyway, Paimon's really curious about that mysterious island that lady just mentioned!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you wanna find the island too, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Who knows, there might be treasure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all the amazing places we've explored during our adventures, finding some mysterious island should be a walk in the park for us!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But we don't have any info about this island.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, you're right... The lady mentioned that the mysterious island is related to a legend of the People of the Springs... So maybe we can start by asking some of them about it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Time's ticking. Let's get started on our next adventure!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But the real question is... who should we ask?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can we just talk to the chief?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... that's an idea. If anyone, the chief of the tribe should know the details!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: G—Get back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't panic, just hang in there!

dialogues.speaker: Karya
dialogues.text: Ah, finally, someone's coming... Please, help us!
